title: P-52 Merlin (Kruger Intergalactic, Star Citizen)

sources.title: Star Citizen game files: defaultProfile.xml and layout_t16000m_dual.xml (Data.p4k, build 4.8)

intro: The P-52 Merlin is a tiny single-seat snub fighter from Kruger Intergalactic in Star Citizen. It rides docked at the back of a Constellation and is built for scouting nearby and short, fast fights. It uses the common controls without changes.

panels.name: P-52 Merlin: weapons and modules
panels.text: This lists the P-52 Merlin's own weapons and special equipment, as the MFD weapons page and the ship data show them.
panels.context: Everything else in this cockpit works as in every Star Citizen ship: the same visor HUD, screens, seat actions and two-stick layout.

controls.name: Pilot guns (three, around a gatling)
controls.text: The Merlin has three guns around a central gatling gun, all fired by the pilot.
controls.context: The pilot fires them with the right stick's trigger in guns mode; the MFD weapons page shows their groups and how they aim.
